name: Burak Yilmaz
bio:
Burak Yilmaz's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with engineering and speed. While pursuing a degree in mechanical engineering at Istanbul Technical University, he became heavily involved in the university's Formula Student team. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to abandon a career in traditional engineering and seek opportunities within the racing world.

He started as a junior mechanic for a small Formula Renault team, quickly proving his aptitude and dedication. Over the years, he climbed the ranks, gaining invaluable experience in various operational roles. He joined ART Grand Prix Academy two years ago, initially as a senior race engineer before transitioning into the head of operations role. Burak approaches his responsibilities with meticulous planning and a strong emphasis on teamwork. He believes that fostering open communication and a collaborative environment are essential for optimizing performance and achieving success on the track. His ability to remain calm and collected under pressure is his defining trait.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Burak is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having Turkish coffee brewed fresh every morning.
